pairs.summary: FOXS1 and SRY motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 14 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; ...). Median lift 1.24x, typical spacing ~48 bp between sites. In 11 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. It is enriched in most profiles, so it may reflect general sequence composition of accessible DNA rather than context-specific cooperation. Caution: overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).

FOXS1 and Hoxa13 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 10 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; ...). Median lift 1.19x, typical spacing ~48 bp between sites. In 10 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only; ChromBPNet contribution scores did not highlight both sites (2 profile(s) tested); no significant ablation synergy. RNA layer (donor-aware within-donor metacell r): HepG2 (hepatocyte, proxy match): CELLxGENE unassessed, Tabula Sapiens unassessed; K562 (erythroid myeloid progenitor, proxy match): CELLxGENE unassessed, Tabula Sapiens unassessed.

CCLA_K562.mapping_note: proxy: K562 (CML erythroleukemia line) -> normal erythroid/MEP/CMP progenitors
